head: Rituals
caption:
You know the thing you keep meaning to do.
Put a stake on it.

head: A fresh wallet.
body:
Nothing in it. One tap
for test tokens.
caption:
Fresh wallet, nothing in it.
One tap for test tokens. Nothing to sign.

head:
What will you do
each week?
caption:
I name what I'll do each week,
and what counts.

head:
Two weeks.
Twenty in all.
body:
Miss a week and that week's
stake goes where I chose.
caption:
Two weeks, twenty in total, ten a week. If I miss a week,
it goes to a demo animal shelter. I pick that, not the app.
Rituals takes nothing.

head: Locked in.
note: Demo speed · a week here is one minute
caption:
Every week's stake is locked.
Demo speed: a week here is one minute.

head: Hold to stamp.
caption:
Now I hold to stamp.
I add a note, just for me.

head: Missed.
body:
No approval.
The app settles it.
caption:
The week closes on its own. Missed.
Ten of the twenty goes to the shelter.

head:
One promise.
Both outcomes.
caption:
Show up: your stake comes back.
Miss: it goes where you chose.

head: Show up, or pay up.
caption:
It's devnet, with test tokens. Rituals takes nothing.
Show up, or pay up.
